data.title: Invitation for personal appointment – Extension of residence permit (Aufenthaltserlaubnis)
data.summary: The Landesamt für Einwanderung Muster invites Nora Musterova to a personal appointment (persönliche Vorsprache) on 15.10.2026 at 10:45, Haus B, Wartebereich 2, to process her application of 01.09.2026 for an extension of her residence permit. She must bring her passport, employer certificate, rental agreement and a biometric photo; her Fiktionsbescheinigung remains valid until the decision.
data.explanation: This is an appointment letter from the immigration office (Ausländerbehörde/Landesamt für Einwanderung) about your residence permit extension request. You need to show up in person on the date and time given, bringing your passport, employer certificate, rental agreement and a biometric photo. Your current Fiktionsbescheinigung (temporary proof of legal stay) stays valid until a decision is made, so you don't need to worry about a gap. If you cannot attend, contact the office using the phone or email given as soon as possible to reschedule, since missing the appointment could delay processing of your application.
